reviews.title: Exactly What I Needed
reviews.author: SteamingCoax
reviews.body: For a while now, I’ve been trying to find a way for me to verbally take notes quickly, add in attachments, transcribe locally, and sync to an Obsidian folder. This app does it perfectly.

reviews.title: The quiet capture powerhouse
reviews.author: Eric Know
reviews.body:
Vox.md has become one of my most-used tools. I picked it up for voice memos into Obsidian, and it quietly transformed my daily capture flow.

The Capture Presets system is brilliant — each preset owns its destination, template, and placement. My voice memos land directly in the right daily note, formatted exactly as I want, zero friction. On-device transcription (Apple Speech, optional Whisper and Parakeet) keeps everything private.

The 2.x line has been refined update after update: durable capture queue, Watch pause/resume, speaker diarization, wide localization. Fast, thoughtful iterations from a developer who clearly uses the app himself.

And beyond voice — text, links, photos, scans, sketches, files — the same presets handle it all. I'm just starting to explore the full range, but it opens a whole world for a serious note-taker.

Five stars, and a genuine thank you.
